basics.name: Yuanxun Gu
basics.label: Cloud Native Developer & DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: Experienced Senior DevOps Engineer with a strong background in cloud-native software development, seeking to leverage expertise in innovative cloud services and enabling technologies.

work.name: SAP SE
highlights: Hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning and inference (Ludwig, Llama Factory, Azure/OpenAI API, Argo Workflows).
Managed Kubernetes clusters via GitOps (Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD).
Developed Kubernetes operators and integrated cloud-native services with SAP BTP.
System DevOps for automotive network project Catena-X (Golang, Argo CD, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions).

work.name: SAP Customer Experience
highlights: Backend development (Golang, Node.js, OpenAPI, Docker, Kubernetes).
Implemented CI/CD pipelines and end-to-end tests.
Conducted API stress tests using Locust.
Guided junior developers and served as Scrum Master.

work.name: SAP Hybris
highlights: Consultancy and technical advice for private cloud platforms.
Built internal tools for DevOps automation (Java, Spring Boot, Bash, MySQL).

work.name: DOCOMO Communications Laboratories Europe
highlights: R&D in augmented reality and indoor localization.
Developed Android prototypes and customized DASH video players.
Presented demos at major events (e.g., NTT DOCOMO R&D Open House 2011, Japan).
Published two Android games on Google Play Store.
Research in AR and mobile visualization; 6+ conference papers and a book chapter.
Supervised undergraduate dissertations; multiple awards including Splash Award (Singapore Computer Society).
Final year dissertation on P2P multicast traffic theory.
Dean’s List in 2006 and 2009.
Designed and implemented a vision-controlled entertaining robot.
Awards include Innovative Mechanism Design Award and multiple Book Prizes.
